analysis_steps.goal: Measure kpc-core and jet flux densities

method.value: Regrid and convolve all images to 18.1" x 18.1"; core flux = peak in central beam; jets = region sum minus core

evidence.quote: Since the kpc-core is unresolved, its flux density is equal to the peak flux within the central synthesized beam. The flux density of the jets is the sum of the emission in the selected region minus the flux density of the kpc-core.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit synchrotron spectra with CI and CI_OFF models

method.value: Fit continuous injection and injection-plus-turn-off models to lobe, core and jet spectra, choosing by reduced chi-squared

evidence.quote: To determine the best-fit models, we use the software package `SYNAGE++` (cite: murgia1999)
Assuming that the magnetic field of the lobes is $2.6\pm 0.3\mu$G (cite: isobe2006; tashiro2009)

assumptions.value: Jaffe & Perola isotropic electron distribution; no escape of particles (T_conf = infinity)

evidence.quote: We assume that the distribution of electrons stays isotropic during its losses, which is known as the Jaffe &Perola approximation (cite: jaffe1973).

fitting.value: reduced chi-squared comparison of CI vs CI_OFF

evidence.quote: We use the reduced-chi-squared to determine which model is best fits the spectrum.

findings_qualitative.value: Lobes have double-shell morphology with filaments in diffuse cocoon

evidence.quote: the lobes of Fornax A have a double-shell morphology, where dense filaments are embedded in a diffuse and extended cocoon.

claims.hypothesis: Were the lobes formed by multiple episodes of nuclear activity?
claims.experiment: Compared radiative age (~24 Myr) with dynamical age (~200 Myr) and spectral fits
claims.result: CI_OFF fits lobes best; dynamical age much exceeds radiative age
claims.finding: Multiple episodes inflated the lobes; last injection started ~24 Myr ago and stopped 12 Myr ago

evidence.quote: For the first time, we show that multiple episodes of nuclear activity must have formed the extended radio lobes.

claims.hypothesis: Is the central emission a remnant of the lobe-forming activity?
claims.experiment: CI and CI_OFF fits to kpc-core and jets including ALMA 108 GHz
claims.result: Jets better fit by CI_OFF (~3 Myr), core by CI
claims.finding: Fornax A is rapidly flickering and the core may be active again

evidence.quote: Currently, the core may be in a new active phase. It appears that Fornax A is rapidly flickering.

why_this_data.value: Arcsecond-resolution data needed to resolve central emission; ALMA 108 GHz used for core at high frequency

evidence.quote: To achieve the second goal we need images with $\sim 10\ensuremath{''}$ angular resolution to resolve the central emission.

limitations_admitted.value: Core result holds only if thermal contamination of 108 GHz flux is below ~80%, which is poorly constrained

evidence.quote: This result holds as long as the thermal contamination to the 108 GHz flux of the kpc-core, poorly constrained by currently available data, is $\lesssim 80\%$.
